MY.en: 10 universities in three groups. Selective: the three highest-placed in QS World University Rankings 2027 (UM, USM, UKM). Middle: ranked public and private universities with moderate published requirements. Accessible: private universities and UUM with lower published English minimums or fees. UiTM is not listed because it shows no full bachelor’s route for international applicants.
MY.uz: 3 guruhdagi 10 ta universitet. Kuchli tanlov: QS World University Rankings 2027 da eng yuqori o‘rinlardagi uchtasi (UM, USM, UKM). O‘rta: o‘rtacha talablarga ega reytingli davlat va xususiy universitetlar. Qulayroq: e’lon qilingan ingliz tili minimumi yoki narxi pastroq bo‘lgan xususiy universitetlar va UUM. UiTM ro‘yxatda yo‘q, chunki u xalqaro abituriyentlar uchun to‘liq bakalavr yo‘lini ko‘rsatmaydi.

HU.en: 10 universities in three groups. Selective: ELTE (highest-placed in QS 2027 here), Semmelweis (medicine, with its own entrance exam) and Corvinus (tests and interviews, higher fees). Middle: Debrecen, Szeged, BME and Pécs. Accessible: Pannonia, MATE and Miskolc, with lower fees. This is EduBridge’s grouping, not an official national ranking.
HU.uz: 3 guruhdagi 10 ta universitet. Kuchli tanlov: ELTE (bu yerda QS 2027 da eng yuqori), Semmelweis (tibbiyot, o‘z kirish imtihoni bilan) va Corvinus (test va suhbat, kontrakti yuqoriroq). O‘rta: Debrecen, Szeged, BME va Pécs. Qulayroq: kontrakti pastroq bo‘lgan Pannonia, MATE va Miskolc. Bu EduBridge guruhlashi, rasmiy milliy reyting emas.

DE.en: 10 universities in three groups. Selective: TUM, Heidelberg and RWTH Aachen (top QS 2027 positions, competitive and often restricted programmes; TUM and Heidelberg charge non-EU tuition). Middle: FU Berlin, TU Dresden, Freiburg and TU Darmstadt. Accessible: TU Berlin, Bonn and FAU — public universities without tuition fees for most programmes at the time of checking (FAU announced fees for some non-EU programmes from 2027). In Germany you still need a recognised entrance qualification (or the Studienkolleg) everywhere.
DE.uz: 3 guruhdagi 10 ta universitet. Kuchli tanlov: TUM, Heidelberg va RWTH Aachen (QS 2027 da yuqori o‘rinlar, raqobatli va ko‘pincha cheklangan dasturlar; TUM va Heidelberg non-EU talabalardan kontrakt oladi). O‘rta: FU Berlin, TU Dresden, Freiburg va TU Darmstadt. Qulayroq: TU Berlin, Bonn va FAU — tekshiruv paytida ko‘pchilik dasturlarda kontrakt yo‘q davlat universitetlari (FAU 2027-yildan ayrim non-EU dasturlarga to‘lov e’lon qilgan). Germaniyada hamma joyda tan olingan kirish malakasi (yoki Studienkolleg) kerak.

TR.en: 10 universities in three groups. Selective: METU, Boğaziçi and ITU — the top-placed public universities in QS 2027, with high demand. Middle: Sabancı, Bilkent (private, higher fees, scholarships available), Yıldız Technical and Gebze Technical. Accessible: Gazi, Ankara and Istanbul University — large public universities with lower fees and many programmes. Groups are EduBridge guidance; positions are QS 2027 as published by YÖK.
TR.uz: 3 guruhdagi 10 ta universitet. Kuchli tanlov: METU, Boğaziçi va ITU — QS 2027 da eng yuqori o‘rindagi davlat universitetlari, talab katta. O‘rta: Sabancı, Bilkent (xususiy, kontrakti yuqoriroq, grantlar bor), Yıldız Technical va Gebze Technical. Qulayroq: Gazi, Ankara va Istanbul University — kontrakti pastroq va dasturlari ko‘p yirik davlat universitetlari. Guruhlar EduBridge tavsiyasi; o‘rinlar YÖK e’lon qilgan QS 2027 bo‘yicha.

KR.en: 10 universities in three groups. Selective: SNU, KAIST and Yonsei — top QS 2027 positions and very competitive international admission. Middle: Hanyang, Kyung Hee, UNIST and Chung-Ang. Accessible: Sejong, Kyungpook and Pusan National University, with lower placements and, at the national universities, lower fees. Korea University and POSTECH were left out only to keep 10 per country.
KR.uz: 3 guruhdagi 10 ta universitet. Kuchli tanlov: SNU, KAIST va Yonsei — QS 2027 da yuqori o‘rinlar va juda raqobatli xalqaro qabul. O‘rta: Hanyang, Kyung Hee, UNIST va Chung-Ang. Qulayroq: Sejong, Kyungpook va Pusan National University — o‘rni pastroq, milliy universitetlarda kontrakt ham pastroq. Korea University va POSTECH faqat har davlatda 10 ta saqlash uchun chiqarildi.
